sections.text: Single sign-on is how every user and job logs in to vCenter: its services, the certificate that signs its tokens, its identity sources, and a real login by a test domain account. The OCSP responders and the CRLs are what smart card logins check revocation with - both asked from the AAP node: whether each vCenter reaches them too is not seen from here.
sections.title: Single sign-on and OCSP
